messages:
alex: Got a frantic bug report: Expo app throws on import of redwood-sdk. Metro: "Unable to resolve module 'stream' from .../node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/index.mjs". SDK published as ESM-only.
marie: Expo managed + Metro often choke on ESM + conditional exports. Are you using Expo Go or a dev client?
sam: Expo Go (SDK 48). Tried adding extraNodeModules -> stream-browserify + react-native-crypto but then runtime crashes on random bytes.
ajex: (meant alex) The bundle ballooned and we hit polyfill incompatibilities.
jess: Two pragmatic fixes: 1) add a react-native-specific entrypoint and set the "react-native" field in package.json, 2) publish a small CJS fallback for older bundlers. Metro tends to prefer the react-native field.
marie: Yep. Also ensure package.json includes "main" (cjs) and "module" (esm) so non-RN bundlers behave. Conditional exports alone are fragile for Metro.
sam: Typescript is another pain: our types reference Node ReadableStream/Buffer and RN projects complain: "Cannot find name 'ReadableStream'".
jess: For types we should ship RN-friendly d.ts alongside the main types that avoid Node globals, or add an ambient typings file users can drop in. NPM doesn't support conditional types well.
alex: For RNG, Hermes won't always have crypto.getRandomValues. We should runtime-detect and fallback to react-native-get-random-values or expo-random: `if (!globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues) require('react-native-get-random-values')`.
sam: Idea: build dist/rn/ bundle that uses tiny internal shims: replace Node streams with simple async iterators for token streaming (we don't need full Node streams), and shim crypto calls. Then set "react-native": "dist/rn/index.js" in package.json.
marie: Add docs: recommended metro.config snippet, polyfill list, TS quickstart (add lib: ["dom","es2020"] or include ambient types), and note Expo Go vs custom dev client caveats.
jess: I'll write RFC for sdk-rn-entrypoints and add a CI job that runs `expo prebuild` + bundle check on our sample app to prevent regressions. Will also include a minimal sample app for onboarding.
dev-bot: RFC #248 (sdk-rn-entrypoints) assigned to @jess, due in 5 days.
alex: I pushed a private repro repo and will attach it to the ticket: https://github.com/redwood/repro-rn-sdk-esm (private). Sam, can you prototype the rollup target?
sam: Yep, I'll replace stream with an async-iterator helper and wire RNG fallback. Will share PR with bundle size numbers.
marie: Great. This should make Expo/React Native a first-class DX path instead of a footnote.
jess: Thanks team — will coordinate the RFC and docs PR.
